"use client";

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ArrowRight, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";
import { useLanguage } from "@/components/LanguageProvider";
import { getHomepageTranslation } from "@/translations/homepage";
import { getDirection } from "@/i18n";

export default function TripTypeDropdown({
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: "oneWay" | "return") => void;
}) {
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const tt = getHomepageTranslation(language).tripType;
  const direction = getDirection(language);
  const tripType = value === "oneWay" ? "oneWay" : "return";
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const dropdownId = useId();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    function handleOutside(event: PointerEvent) {
      if (
        event.target instanceof Node &&
        !containerRef.current?.contains(event.target)
      ) {
        setOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", handleOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", handleOutside);
  }, [open]);

  const handleSelect = (type: "oneWay" | "return") => {
    onChange(type);
    setOpen(false);
    triggerRef.current?.focus();
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      dir={direction}
      className="relative inline-block"
      onBlur={(event) => {
        if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget)) setOpen(false);
      }}
      onKeyDown={(event) => {
        // Close this dropdown before allowing Escape to close the date dialog.
        if (event.key === "Escape" && open) {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopPropagation();
          setOpen(false);
          triggerRef.current?.focus();
        }
      }}
    >
      <button
        ref={triggerRef}
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((previous) => !previous)}
        aria-label={tt.toggleAria}
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={dropdownId}
        className="cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-white text-sm font-medium text-gray-900"
      >
        {tripType === "oneWay" ? tt.oneWayLabel : tt.returnLabel}
        <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-xs">▾</span>
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div
          id={dropdownId}
          role="group"
          aria-label={tt.toggleAria}
          className="absolute start-0 mt-2 w-48 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-lg shadow-md z-10"
        >
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-pressed={tripType === "return"}
            onClick={() => handleSelect("return")}
            className="w-full text-start px-3 py-2 text-sm hover:bg-gray-100 text-black flex items-center gap-4 font-bold"
          >
            <RotateCcw aria-hidden="true" className="size-6" /> {tt.returnLabel}
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            aria-pressed={tripType === "oneWay"}
            onClick={() => handleSelect("oneWay")}
            className="w-full text-start px-3 py-2 text-sm hover:bg-gray-100 text-black flex items-center font-bold gap-4"
          >
            <ArrowRight aria-hidden="true" className={`size-6 ${direction === "rtl" ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} /> {tt.oneWayLabel}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function getCountryName(code: string, fallback: string, language: string): string {
  const region = code.trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(region) || region === "ZZ") return fallback;
  try {
    return new Intl.DisplayNames([language], {
      type: "region",
      fallback: "none",
    }).of(region) || fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

export default function CountryCard({ country, onSelect }: CountryCardProps) {
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const t = translations[language] ?? translations.en;
  const countryName = getCountryName(country.code, country.country, language);
  const price = new Intl.NumberFormat(language, {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "EUR",
    minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(country.startingPrice);
  return (
    <article dir={getDirection(language)} className="group bg-white rounded-3xl overflow-hidden border border-gray-200 shadow-md hover:shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer">
      {/* Country Image */}
      <div className="relative h-52 overflow-hidden">
        <Image
          src={country.image}
          alt={countryName}
          fill
          className="object-cover group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-500"
        />

        {/* Flag */}
        <div className="absolute top-4 start-4 bg-white rounded-full px-3 py-1 shadow-lg text-lg">
          {country.flag}
        </div>

        {/* Instant Badge */}
        <div className="absolute top-4 end-4 bg-green-600 text-white px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold shadow-lg">

        </div>
      </div>

type ApiPackage = {
  packageCode?: string;
  slug?: string | null;
  name?: string;
  data?: string | null;
  volume?: number | null;
  duration?: number | null;
  durationUnit?: string;
  validity?: string | null;
  network?: string;
  coverage?: string;
  countryCode?: string;
  price?: number;
  displayPrice?: string;
  currency?: "EUR" | string;
  instantDelivery?: boolean;
};

type ApiResponse = {
  success?: boolean;
  errorCode?: string | null;
  errorMsg?: string | null;
  countryCode?: string;
  packageCount?: number;
  packages?: ApiPackage[];
};

function formatData(volume?: number | null, name?: string): string {
  if (typeof volume === "number" && volume > 0) {
    const gb = volume / 1024 / 1024 / 1024;

    if (gb >= 1) {
      return `${Number(gb.toFixed(2))}GB`;
    }

    return `${Math.round(volume / 1024 / 1024)}MB`;
  }

  const match = name?.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(GB|MB)/i);
  const amount = match?.[1];
  const unit = match?.[2];

  return amount && unit ? `${amount}${unit.toUpperCase()}` : "Data";
}

function mapPackage(
  packageItem: ApiPackage,
  index: number,
): EsimPackage | null {
  if (
    !packageItem.packageCode ||
    typeof packageItem.price !== "number" ||
    packageItem.price <= 0 ||
    packageItem.currency !== "EUR"
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    id: index + 1,
    packageCode: packageItem.packageCode,
    title: packageItem.name || "eSIM Package",
    price: packageItem.price,
    days: packageItem.duration ?? 0,
    data: formatData(packageItem.volume, packageItem.name),
    network: packageItem.network || "4G / 5G",
    coverage:
      packageItem.coverage || packageItem.countryCode || "International",
    activation: packageItem.instantDelivery === false ? undefined : "Instant",
    locationCode: packageItem.countryCode,
    slug: packageItem.slug ?? undefined,
  };
}

export default function EsimHome() {
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const t = translations[language] ?? translations.en;
  const [countries, setCountries] = useState<Country[]>(initialCountries);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(false);
  const [selectedCountry, setSelectedCountry] = useState<Country | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadPackages() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(false);

      let successfulRequests = 0;

      const loadedCountries = await Promise.all(
        initialCountries.map(async (country) => {
          try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/esim/packages", {
              method: "POST",
              headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
              body: JSON.stringify({ locationCode: country.code }),
              cache: "no-store",
            });

            const result = (await response.json()) as ApiResponse;

            if (!response.ok || !result.success) {
              throw new Error(
                result.errorMsg || `API request failed: ${response.status}`,
              );
            }

            successfulRequests += 1;

            const packages = (result.packages ?? [])
              .map(mapPackage)
              .filter((item): item is EsimPackage => item !== null)
              .sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price);

            return {
              ...country,
              packages,
              packageCount: packages.length,
              startingPrice: packages[0]?.price ?? 0,
            };
          } catch (countryError) {
            console.error(`Failed loading ${country.code}:`, countryError);
            return country;
          }
        }),
      );

      if (cancelled) return;

      setCountries(loadedCountries);

      if (successfulRequests === 0) {
        setError(true);
      }

      setLoading(false);
    }

    void loadPackages();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <>
      <section dir={getDirection(language)} className="py-10">
        <div className="mb-10">
          <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold lg:text-4xl">
            <span dir="ltr" className="text-[#0F91D5]">HT Connect</span>{" "}{t.heading}
          </h2>

          <p className="mt-4 max-w-4xl leading-7 text-gray-600">
            {t.description}
          </p>
        </div>

        {loading && (
          <div role="status" className="py-12 text-center">
            <div className="inline-block h-10 w-10 animate-spin rounded-full border-4 border-gray-200 border-t-[#0F91D5]" />
            <p className="mt-4 text-gray-500">{t.loading}</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {error && !loading && (
          <div role="alert" className="rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-5 text-red-700">
            {t.error}
          </div>
        )}

        {!loading && !error && (
          <CountryGrid countries={countries} onSelect={setSelectedCountry} />
        )}
      </section>

      <PackageModal
        country={selectedCountry}
        onClose={() => setSelectedCountry(null)}
      />
    </>
  );
}

function localizeCountry(code: string, fallback: string, language: string): string {
  const region = code.trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(region) || region === "ZZ") return fallback;
  try {
    return new Intl.DisplayNames([language], { type: "region", fallback: "none" }).of(region) || fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

export default function PackageModal({ country, onClose }: PackageModalProps) {
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const t = translations[language] ?? translations.en;
  const formatPrice = (price: number) => new Intl.NumberFormat(language, {
    style: "currency", currency: "EUR",
  }).format(price);
  const formatDays = (days: number) => new Intl.NumberFormat(language, {
    style: "unit", unit: "day", unitDisplay: "long",
  }).format(days);
  const displayValue = (value: string | null | undefined) => {
    if (!value?.trim()) return t.notSpecified;
    if (value === "Instant") return t.instant;
    if (value === "International") return t.international;
    if (value === "Data") return t.data;
    return value;
  };
  const [selectedPackage, setSelectedPackage] = useState<EsimPackage | null>(
    null,
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedPackage(null);
  }, [country?.id]);

  const closePackages = () => {
    setSelectedPackage(null);
    onClose();
  };

  if (!country) return null;
  const countryName = localizeCountry(country.code, country.country, language);

  return (
    <>
      <div
        dir={getDirection(language)}
        className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4"
        onClick={closePackages}
      >
        <div
          className="bg-white rounded-3xl w-full max-w-3xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto shadow-2xl"
          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="p-6 border-b">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">
                  {country.flag} {countryName}
                </h2>

                <p className="text-gray-500 mt-2">{t.choose}</p>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label={t.close}
                onClick={closePackages}
                className="text-3xl text-gray-500 hover:text-black"
              >
                ×
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Packages */}

          <div className="p-6 space-y-5">
            {country.packages.length === 0 && <p role="status" className="text-gray-500">{t.noPackages}</p>}
            {country.packages.map((pkg) => (
              <div
                key={pkg.id}
                className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 p-6 hover:border-[#0F91D5] hover:shadow-lg transition"
              >
                <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:justify-between lg:items-center gap-5">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-xl font-bold">{pkg.title === "eSIM Package" ? t.packageTitle : pkg.title}</h3>

                    <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-8 gap-y-2 text-sm text-gray-600">
                      <div>
                        <strong>{t.data}:</strong> {displayValue(pkg.data)}
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <strong>{t.validity}:</strong> {formatDays(pkg.days)}
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <strong>{t.coverage}:</strong> {localizeCountry(pkg.coverage || "", displayValue(pkg.coverage), language)}
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <strong>{t.network}:</strong> {displayValue(pkg.network)}
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <strong>{t.operator}:</strong> {displayValue(pkg.operator)}
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <strong>{t.activation}:</strong> {displayValue(pkg.activation)}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-center">
                    <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-[#0F91D5]">
                      <bdi>{formatPrice(pkg.price)}</bdi>
                    </p>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setSelectedPackage(pkg)}
                      className="mt-4 w-full lg:w-auto bg-[#0F91D5] hover:bg-[#0d80bd] text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-xl font-semibold transition"
                    >
                      {t.buyNow}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <PaymentDialog
        open={selectedPackage !== null}
        packageItem={selectedPackage}
        country={country}
        onClose={() => setSelectedPackage(null)}
      />
    </>
  );
}

function getCountryName(code: string, fallback: string, language: string): string {
  const region = code.trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(region) || region === "ZZ") return fallback;
  try {
    return new Intl.DisplayNames([language], { type: "region", fallback: "none" }).of(region) || fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

export default function PaymentDialog({
  open,
  packageItem,
  country,
  onClose,
}: PaymentDialogProps) {
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const t = translations[language] ?? translations.en;
  const titleId = useId();
  const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const active = open && !!packageItem && !!country;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) return;
    const previousFocus = document.activeElement;
    const previousOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    dialogRef.current?.focus();
    function handleKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key === "Escape") { event.preventDefault(); onClose(); }
      if (event.key === "Tab") {
        const buttons = Array.from(dialogRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('button:not([disabled])') ?? []);
        const first = buttons[0];
        const last = buttons[buttons.length - 1];
        if (!first || !last) { event.preventDefault(); return; }
        if (event.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === first || document.activeElement === dialogRef.current)) {
          event.preventDefault(); last.focus();
        } else if (!event.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === last || document.activeElement === dialogRef.current)) {
          event.preventDefault(); first.focus();
        }
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleKey);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKey);
      document.body.style.overflow = previousOverflow;
      if (previousFocus instanceof HTMLElement) previousFocus.focus();
    };
  }, [active, onClose]);

  if (!open || !packageItem || !country) return null;

  const countryName = getCountryName(country.code, country.country, language);
  const price = new Intl.NumberFormat(language, { style: "currency", currency: "EUR" }).format(packageItem.price);
  const validity = new Intl.NumberFormat(language, { style: "unit", unit: "day", unitDisplay: "long" }).format(packageItem.days);

  const handleING = () => {
    alert(t.ingNotice);
  };

  const handleMollie = () => {
    alert(t.mollieNotice);
  };

  return (
    <div
      dir={getDirection(language)}
      className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-[60] p-4"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        ref={dialogRef}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby={titleId}
        tabIndex={-1}
        className="bg-white rounded-3xl w-full max-w-lg shadow-2xl max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] overflow-y-auto"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="bg-[#0F91D5] text-white p-6">
          <h2 id={titleId} className="text-2xl font-bold">{t.title}</h2>

          <p className="text-blue-100 mt-2">{t.subtitle}</p>
        </div>

        {/* Body */}
        <div className="p-6">
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-gray-500">{t.country}</span>

              <span className="font-semibold">
                {country.flag} {countryName}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-gray-500">{t.package}</span>

              <span className="font-semibold">{packageItem.title === "eSIM Package" ? t.packageTitle : packageItem.title}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-gray-500">{t.data}</span>

              <span className="font-semibold">{packageItem.data === "Data" ? t.data : packageItem.data}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-gray-500">{t.validity}</span>

              <span className="font-semibold">{validity}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="border-t mt-6 pt-6">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <span className="text-xl font-bold">{t.total}</span>

              <span className="text-3xl font-bold text-[#0F91D5]">
                <bdi>{price}</bdi>
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Payment Buttons */}

          <div className="mt-8 space-y-4">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleING}
              className="w-full bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600 text-white font-bold py-4 rounded-xl transition"
            >
              {t.payING}
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleMollie}
              className="w-full bg-[#0F91D5] hover:bg-[#0b7cbc] text-white font-bold py-4 rounded-xl transition"
            >
              {t.payMollie}
            </button>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="mt-6 w-full bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 py-3 rounded-xl font-semibold"
          >
            {t.cancel}

"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { ChevronUp } from "lucide-react";
import { FaToggleOff } from "react-icons/fa";
import { useLanguage } from "@/components/LanguageProvider";
import { interpolate } from "@/lib/createTranslator";
import { getPackagesTranslation } from "@/translations/packages";

const VISIBLE_COUNT = 4;

/**
 * Package inclusions list.
 * Labels are translated; the inclusion items themselves are package data
 * and stay as supplied (English), wrapped in <bdi> so they render cleanly
 * inside right-to-left pages.
 */
export const PackagesBenefits = ({ benefits }: { benefits: string[] }) => {
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(false);
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const t = getPackagesTranslation(language).benefits;

  // Show only the first items unless expanded
  const displayedBenefits = isExpanded ? benefits : benefits.slice(0, VISIBLE_COUNT);
  const remainingCount = benefits.length - VISIBLE_COUNT;

  return (
    <div className="text-xs text-gray-600 space-y-1 mb-3 text-start">
      <p className="font-semibold text-black flex items-center mb-2">
        <FaToggleOff aria-hidden="true" className="size-5 me-2 shrink-0" />
        {t.includes}
      </p>

      {displayedBenefits.map((pkg, ind) => (
        <p key={ind} className="flex items-start">
          <span
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="text-[#0F91D5] me-2 font-bold text-lg leading-none"
          >
            .
          </span>
          <bdi className="min-w-0">{pkg}</bdi>
        </p>
      ))}

      {benefits.length > VISIBLE_COUNT && (
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-expanded={isExpanded}
          onClick={() => setIsExpanded((previous) => !previous)}
          className="text-[#0F91D5] font-semibold mt-2 flex items-center hover:underline transition-all"
        >
          {isExpanded ? (
            <>
              {t.showLess}
              <ChevronUp aria-hidden="true" className="ms-1 size-3" />
            </>
          ) : (
            interpolate(t.moreBenefits, { count: remainingCount })
          )}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

type PackageItem = (typeof packages)[number];

const ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 4;

const isNumericPrice = (price: string) =>
  price !== "On Request" && price !== "Custom";

const PopularTourPackages: React.FC = () => {
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const t = getPackagesTranslation(language).popular;
  const direction = getDirection(language);
  const isRTL = direction === "rtl";

  // In RTL the "previous" control sits on the right and points right.
  const PrevIcon = isRTL ? ChevronRight : ChevronLeft;
  const NextIcon = isRTL ? ChevronLeft : ChevronRight;

  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [activeImageIndexes, setActiveImageIndexes] = useState<{ [key: number]: number }>({});

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(packages.length / ITEMS_PER_PAGE);

  const currentPackages = useMemo(() => {
    const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
    const endIndex = startIndex + ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
    return packages.slice(startIndex, endIndex);
  }, [currentPage]);

  const handlePageChange = (page: number) => {
    setCurrentPage(page);
  };

  const handlePrevImage = (id: number, maxImages: number) => {
    setActiveImageIndexes((prev) => {
      const currentIndex = prev[id] || 0;
      const nextIndex = currentIndex === 0 ? maxImages - 1 : currentIndex - 1;
      return { ...prev, [id]: nextIndex };
    });
  };

  const handleNextImage = (id: number, maxImages: number) => {
    setActiveImageIndexes((prev) => {
      const currentIndex = prev[id] || 0;
      const nextIndex = currentIndex === maxImages - 1 ? 0 : currentIndex + 1;
      return { ...prev, [id]: nextIndex };
    });
  };

  // The office always receives this message in English.
  const handleBooking = (item: PackageItem) => {
    const phoneNumber = "31104857673";

    const rawMessage = `Hello, I am interested in booking a package. Here are the details:

🌟 *Package Name:* ${item.title}
📍 *Location:* ${item.location}
🕒 *Duration:* ${item.duration}
💶 *Price:* ${item.price} per person
🛫 *Next Departure:* ${item.nextDeparture}

Please provide me with more details regarding availability and booking requirements. Thank you!`;

    const encodedMessage = encodeURIComponent(rawMessage);
    const whatsappUrl = `https://wa.me/${phoneNumber}?text=${encodedMessage}`;
    window.open(whatsappUrl, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
  };

  const getPriceLabel = (price: string) => {
    if (price === "On Request") return t.onRequest;
    if (price === "Custom") return t.custom;
    return `€ ${price}`;
  };

  const getDepartureLabel = (value: string) => {
    if (value === "On request") return t.departureOnRequest;
    if (value === "Any time") return t.departureAnyTime;
    return value;
  };

  return (
    <section dir={direction} className="relative py-16 overflow-hidden">
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="absolute inset-0 bg-cover bg-center bg-no-repeat opacity-15 z-0"
        style={{ backgroundImage: "url('/assets/bgimage/h1.webp')" }}
      />

      <div aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0 bg-linear-to-b from-[rgba(207,234,246,0.15)] to-[rgba(85,178,218,0.25)] z-0" />
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0 bg-white/35 z-0" />

      <div className="container relative z-10 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4">

        <div className="text-center mb-12">
          <h2 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold text-[#0F91D5]">
            {t.titleHighlight} <span className="text-black">{t.titleRest}</span>
          </h2>

          <p className="text-gray-600 mt-3 text-sm md:text-base max-w-2xl mx-auto">
            {t.description}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8">
          {currentPackages.map((item) => {
            const currentImgIndex = activeImageIndexes[item.id] || 0;
            const numeric = isNumericPrice(item.price);

            return (
              <div
                key={item.id}
                className="bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-md rounded-2xl shadow-xl overflow-hidden hover:scale-105 transition duration-300 flex flex-col h-full border border-white/30"
              >
                <div className="relative group/slider">
                  <img
                    src={item.images[currentImgIndex]}
                    className="h-52 w-full object-cover transition-all duration-300"
                    alt={interpolate(t.imageAlt, {
                      title: item.title,
                      number: currentImgIndex + 1,
                    })}
                  />

                  <button
                    onClick={() => handlePrevImage(item.id, item.images.length)}
                    className="absolute start-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 bg-black/50 text-white p-1 rounded-full transition duration-200 hover:bg-black/70 z-10"
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={t.previousImage}
                  >
                    <PrevIcon size={20} aria-hidden="true" />
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleNextImage(item.id, item.images.length)}
                    className="absolute end-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 bg-black/50 text-white p-1 rounded-full transition duration-200 hover:bg-black/70 z-10"
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={t.nextImage}
                  >
                    <NextIcon size={20} aria-hidden="true" />
                  </button>

                  {/* PRICE BADGE */}
                  <div className="absolute top-3 end-3 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-sm px-3 py-2 rounded-xl shadow text-[#0F91D5] font-semibold text-sm w-[110px] h-[58px] flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center leading-tight">
                    {numeric && (
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">{t.from}</div>
                    )}

                    <div className="text-sm font-bold">
                      <bdi>{getPriceLabel(item.price)}</bdi>
                    </div>

                    {numeric && (
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">{t.perPerson}</div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div dir="ltr" className="absolute bottom-0 bg-white rounded-md start-2 p-1 text-xs text-gray-500 mb-2">
                    ⭐ 4.8 (365)
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="p-4 text-start flex flex-col flex-grow">
                  <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm mb-1">
                    <bdi>{item.title}</bdi>
                  </h3>

                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-3">
                    <span aria-hidden="true">🕒 </span>
                    <bdi>{item.duration}</bdi>
                  </p>

                  <div className="bg-[#F8F9FA] p-5 rounded-lg text-xs mb-3">
                    <div className="flex gap-2 items-start">
                      <Hotel aria-hidden="true" className="text-[#058BD0] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <p className="font-bold block w-full">
                          <bdi>{item.stay.name}</bdi>
                        </p>
                        <span aria-hidden="true" className="flex mt-1">
                          {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, index) => (
                            <Star key={index} className="fill-yellow-400 text-yellow-400 size-4 inline me-0.5" />
                          ))}
                        </span>
                        <div className="font-normal mt-1 text-gray-600">
                          <bdi>{item.stay.room}</bdi>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <PackagesBenefits benefits={item.packages} />

                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-4">
                    {item.experice.map((exp, ind) => (
                      <p key={ind} className="bg-[#E3F2FD] text-[#0F91D5] text-[10px] px-2 py-1 rounded-xl">
                        <bdi>{exp}</bdi>
                      </p>
                    ))}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex justify-between gap-2 text-xs mb-4 mt-auto">
                    <span className="flex items-center">
                      <PlaneTakeoff aria-hidden="true" className="me-2 size-4 shrink-0" />
                      {t.nextDepartureLabel}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-medium">
                      {getDepartureLabel(item.nextDeparture)}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleBooking(item)}
                    className="w-full bg-[#0F91D5] font-bold text-white py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-blue-700 transition mt-2"
                  >
                    {t.bookNow}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* PAGINATION SECTION */}
        <nav
          aria-label={t.paginationLabel}
          className="flex justify-center items-center flex-wrap mt-12 gap-3 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handlePageChange(Math.max(currentPage - 1, 1))}
            disabled={currentPage === 1}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition ${
              currentPage === 1
                ? "bg-gray-100 text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed"
                : "bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-300"
            }`}
          >
            {t.previous}
          </button>

          {Array.from({ length: totalPages }, (_, index) => {
            const page = index + 1;
            return (
              <button
                key={page}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handlePageChange(page)}
                aria-label={interpolate(t.pageLabel, { number: page })}
                aria-current={currentPage === page ? "page" : undefined}
                className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition ${
                  currentPage === page
                    ? "bg-[#0F91D5] text-white shadow-md shadow-blue-500/20"
                    : "bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-300"
                }`}
              >
                {page}
              </button>
            );
          })}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handlePageChange(Math.min(currentPage + 1, totalPages))}
            disabled={currentPage === totalPages}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition ${
              currentPage === totalPages
                ? "bg-gray-100 text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed"
                : "bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-300"
            }`}
          >
            {t.next}
          </button>
        </nav>

      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

export default PopularTourPackages;

/** Renders a card title from translated parts (blue = highlighted). */
function CardTitle({ parts }: { parts: TitlePart[] }) {
  return (
    <>
      {parts.map((part, index) => (
        <span
          key={index}
          className={part.highlight ? "text-[#0F91D5]" : "text-gray-900 font-bold"}
        >
          {part.text}
        </span>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

const SESSION_KEY = "ht_promo_seen";

function hasSeenThisSession(): boolean {
  try {
    return window.sessionStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY) === "1";
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function markSeenThisSession(): void {
  try {
    window.sessionStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, "1");
  } catch {
    // Storage blocked: the popup may show again on the next full load.
  }
}

export default function PromoPopup() {
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const t = getPromoTranslation(language);
  const titleId = useId();
  const descriptionId = useId();
  const closeButtonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);

  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  const closePopup = useCallback(() => {
    setIsOpen(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (SHOW_ONCE_PER_SESSION && hasSeenThisSession()) return;

    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setIsOpen(true);
      if (SHOW_ONCE_PER_SESSION) markSeenThisSession();
    }, 600);

    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    const previousFocus = document.activeElement;
    const previousOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    closeButtonRef.current?.focus();

    const closeOnEscape = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        closePopup();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("keydown", closeOnEscape);

    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = previousOverflow;
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", closeOnEscape);
      if (previousFocus instanceof HTMLElement) previousFocus.focus();
    };
  }, [closePopup, isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      dir={getDirection(language)}
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm sm:p-6"
      role="presentation"
      onMouseDown={(event) => {
        if (event.target === event.currentTarget) {
          closePopup();
        }
      }}
    >
      <section
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby={titleId}
        aria-describedby={descriptionId}
        className="relative grid w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] overflow-y-auto rounded-3xl bg-white shadow-2xl md:grid-cols-[1.05fr_1fr]"
      >
        <button
          ref={closeButtonRef}
          type="button"
          onClick={closePopup}
          aria-label={t.closeLabel}
          className="absolute end-3 top-3 z-10 flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/95 text-2xl leading-none text-gray-700 shadow-md transition hover:bg-gray-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0F91D5]"
        >
          <span aria-hidden="true">&times;</span>
        </button>

        <div className="relative min-h-52 sm:min-h-64 md:min-h-[430px]">
          <Image
            src="/assets/tour.jpg"
            alt={t.imageAlt}
            fill
            priority
            sizes="(max-width: 768px) 100vw, 50vw"
            className="object-cover"
          />
          {/* Gradient fades toward the text side in both directions */}
          <div
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/45 to-transparent md:bg-gradient-to-r md:rtl:bg-gradient-to-l"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col justify-center px-6 py-8 sm:px-10 sm:py-10 text-start">
          <span className="mb-4 w-fit rounded-full bg-[#0F91D5]/10 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest rtl:tracking-normal text-[#0F91D5]">
            {t.badge}
          </span>

          <h2
            id={titleId}
            className="text-3xl font-bold leading-tight text-gray-900 sm:text-4xl"
          >
            {t.title}
          </h2>

          <p
            id={descriptionId}
            className="mt-4 text-base leading-7 text-gray-600"
          >
            {t.description}
          </p>

          <Link
            href="/packages"
            onClick={closePopup}
            className="mt-7 inline-flex min-h-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#0F91D5] px-6 py-3 font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-[#0d80bd] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0F91D5] focus:ring-offset-2"
          >
            {t.cta}
          </Link>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={closePopup}
            className="mt-3 min-h-11 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 transition hover:text-gray-800"
          >
            {t.later}
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import HeadingAndDesc from "./HeadingAndDesc";
import BookingModal from "@/components/ui/BookingModal";
import { useLanguage } from "@/components/LanguageProvider";
import { getDirection } from "@/i18n";

const DEFAULT_WHATSAPP_LINK =
  "https://wa.me/31104857673?text=Hello%20Hassaan%20Travel";

/** Only real web links open in a new tab; tel: and mailto: stay in place. */
const isExternalWebLink = (href: string) => /^https?:\/\//i.test(href);

const BlueBgHeadAndDesc = ({
  head,
  desc,
  btnTxt,
  btnTxt2,
  btnLink,
}: {
  /** Already translated by the parent page. */
  head: string;
  desc: string;
  btnTxt: string;
  /** When set, shows a second button that opens the booking modal. */
  btnTxt2?: string;
  btnLink?: string;
  /**
   * Kept for backwards compatibility with existing pages.
   * The second button intentionally opens the booking modal,
   * so this link is not used.
   */
  btnLink2?: string;
}) => {
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const { language } = useLanguage();

  const primaryHref = btnLink || DEFAULT_WHATSAPP_LINK;
  const opensNewTab = isExternalWebLink(primaryHref);

  return (
    <div dir={getDirection(language)} className="mt-6 sm:mt-10 w-full mb-0">
      <div className="text-white bg-[#0F91D5] shadow-2xl px-6 py-12 md:py-16 text-center w-full">

        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4">
          <HeadingAndDesc head={head} desc={desc} />

          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-center gap-4 mt-6">
            {/* Primary Button */}
            <a
              href={primaryHref}
              target={opensNewTab ? "_blank" : undefined}
              rel={opensNewTab ? "noopener noreferrer" : undefined}
              className="bg-white text-[#0F91D5] font-semibold px-8 py-3.5 rounded-2xl shadow-lg hover:bg-gray-100 transition-all active:scale-95"
            >
              {btnTxt}
            </a>

            {/* Secondary Button – opens the booking modal */}
            {btnTxt2 && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)}
                type="button"
                aria-haspopup="dialog"
                className="bg-[#d4e157] hover:bg-lime-400 text-black font-semibold px-8 py-3.5 rounded-2xl shadow-lg transition flex items-center gap-2 justify-center cursor-pointer border-none active:scale-95"
              >
                {btnTxt2}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Keeps the modal aligned to the viewport, not this container */}
      <div className="fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none z-[9999]">
        <div className="pointer-events-auto">
          <BookingModal
            isOpen={isModalOpen}
            onClose={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default BlueBgHeadAndDesc;

// ─── Default State ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const defaultForm: FormState = {
  name: "",
  email: "",
  telephone: "",
  employ: "",
  travelDate: "",
  additionalWishes: "",
};

// ─── Component ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function BookingModal({ isOpen, onClose }: BookingModalProps) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<FormState>(defaultForm);
  const [status, setStatus]     = useState<SubmitStatus>("idle");

  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const t = translations[language] ?? translations.en;
  const formId = useId();
  const closeTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) setStatus("idle");
    return () => {
      if (closeTimer.current !== null) {
        clearTimeout(closeTimer.current);
        closeTimer.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

// ─── Form Config ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const formFieldsConfig = [
  {
    id: "row-1",
    isRow: true,
    fields: [
      { label: t.name,   name: "name",  type: "text",  placeholder: t.namePlaceholder,       required: true },
      { label: t.email, name: "email", type: "email", placeholder: "your@email.com",  required: true },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: "row-2",
    isRow: true,
    fields: [
      { label: t.telephone, name: "telephone", type: "tel",  placeholder: "+31 123 456 789", required: true },
      { label: t.employ,    name: "employ",    type: "text", placeholder: "",                required: false },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: "travelDate",
    isRow: false,
    label: t.travelDate,
    name: "travelDate",
    type: "date",
    placeholder: "",
    required: true,
  },
  {
    id: "additionalWishes",
    isRow: false,
    label: t.additionalWishes,
    name: "additionalWishes",
    type: "textarea",
    placeholder: t.messagePlaceholder,
    required: false,
    rows: 4,
  },
];

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleChange = (
    e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement>
  ) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
  };

  const handleFormSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setStatus("loading");

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/send-email", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ formType: "booking", ...formData }),
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        setStatus("success");
        setFormData(defaultForm);
        // Close modal after 1.5s so user sees the success message
        closeTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
          setStatus("idle");
          onClose();
        }, 1500);
      } else {
        setStatus("error");
      }
    } catch {
      setStatus("error");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div dir={getDirection(language)} className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">

      {/* DARK OVERLAY */}
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0  bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity"
        onClick={onClose}
      />

      {/* MODAL CARD */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl w-full max-w-135 shadow-2xl relative z-10 max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] overflow-y-auto animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200">

        {/* HEADER */}
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center px-6 pt-6 pb-4">
          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 tracking-tight">
            {t.title}
          </h3>
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label={t.close}
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-100"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* FORM BODY */}
        <form onSubmit={handleFormSubmit} className="px-6 pb-6 space-y-4">
          {formFieldsConfig.map((rowItem) => {

            // 2-column row (Name/Email or Tel/Employ)
            if (rowItem.isRow && rowItem.fields) {
              return (
                <div key={rowItem.id} className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  {rowItem.fields.map((field) => (
                    <div key={field.name}>
                      <label htmlFor={`${formId}-${field.name}`} className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 mb-1.5">
                        {field.label}
                      </label>
                      <input
                        id={`${formId}-${field.name}`}
                        dir={field.type === "email" || field.type === "tel" ? "ltr" : undefined}
                        required={field.required}
                        type={field.type}
                        name={field.name}
                        value={formData[field.name as keyof FormState]}
                        onChange={handleChange}
                        placeholder={field.placeholder || undefined}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg text-sm bg-white outline-none focus:border-[#0F91D5] transition-colors placeholder:text-gray-300 text-gray-800"
                      />
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              );
            }

            // Textarea
            if (rowItem.type === "textarea") {
              return (
                <div key={rowItem.id}>
                  <label htmlFor={`${formId}-${rowItem.name}`} className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 mb-1.5">
                    {rowItem.label}
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    id={`${formId}-${rowItem.name}`}
                    name={rowItem.name}
                    value={formData[rowItem.name as keyof FormState]}
                    onChange={handleChange}
                    rows={rowItem.rows}
                    placeholder={rowItem.placeholder || undefined}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg text-sm bg-white outline-none focus:border-[#0F91D5] transition-colors placeholder:text-gray-300 resize-none text-gray-800"
                  />
                </div>
              );
            }

            // Standard input (Travel Date)
            return (
              <div key={rowItem.id}>
                <label htmlFor={`${formId}-${rowItem.name}`} className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 mb-1.5">
                  {rowItem.label}
                </label>
                <input
                  id={`${formId}-${rowItem.name}`}
                  dir={rowItem.type === "date" ? "ltr" : undefined}
                  required={rowItem.required}
                  type={rowItem.type}
                  name={rowItem.name}
                  value={formData[rowItem.name as keyof FormState]}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  placeholder={rowItem.placeholder || undefined}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg text-sm bg-white outline-none focus:border-[#0F91D5] transition-colors text-gray-800"
                />
              </div>
            );
          })}

          {/* STATUS MESSAGES */}
          {status === "success" && (
            <p role="status" className="text-green-600 text-sm text-center">✅ {t.success}</p>
          )}
          {status === "error" && (
            <p role="alert" className="text-red-500 text-sm text-center">❌ {t.error}</p>
          )}

          {/* SUBMIT BUTTON */}
          <div className="pt-2">
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={status === "loading" || status === "success"}
              className="w-full bg-[#0F91D5] hover:bg-[#0d82c0] text-white py-3 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition-colors shadow-sm cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {status === "loading" ? t.sending : status === "success" ? `✓ ${t.sent}` : t.send}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  JSX,

  useMemo,
  useRef,

  type Dispatch,
  type SetStateAction,
} from "react";

import { useLanguage } from "@/components/LanguageProvider";

import {
  getCustomPackagesTranslation,
  type DurationKey,
  type PreferenceKey,
  type TimeSpanKey,
  type TravelTypeKey,
} from "@/translations/customPackages";

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type CountryCode = "SA" | "AE" | "TR" | "EG" | "MA" | "TH" | "FR" | "IT" | "GB" | "US";
type SubmitStatus = "idle" | "loading" | "success" | "error";
type TravelerKey = "adults" | "children" | "infants";

/** `name` stays English: it is what the office receives by email. */
interface Country { code: CountryCode; name: string }
interface TravelTypeOption { id: TravelTypeKey; icon: JSX.Element }
interface PreferenceOption { id: PreferenceKey; icon: JSX.Element }
interface TravelerRowConfig {
  id: TravelerKey;
  label: string;
  value: number;
  setter: Dispatch<SetStateAction<number>>;
  min: number;
  max?: number;
  helperText?: string;
}

// ─── Props ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface CustomTravelPackagesProps {
  mode?: "umrah" | "packages";
}

// ─── Static Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const countries: Country[] = [
  { code: "SA", name: "Saudi Arabia" },
  { code: "AE", name: "United Arab Emirates" },
  { code: "TR", name: "Turkey" },
  { code: "EG", name: "Egypt" },
  { code: "MA", name: "Morocco" },
  { code: "TH", name: "Thailand" },
  { code: "FR", name: "France" },
  { code: "IT", name: "Italy" },
  { code: "GB", name: "United Kingdom" },
  { code: "US", name: "United States" },
];

const airportsByCountry: Record<CountryCode, string[]> = {
  SA: ["Jeddah (JED)", "Riyadh (RUH)", "Dammam (DMM)", "Medina (MED)"],
  AE: ["Dubai (DXB)", "Abu Dhabi (AUH)", "Sharjah (SHJ)"],
  TR: ["Istanbul (IST)", "Ankara (ESB)", "Antalya (AYT)"],
  EG: ["Cairo (CAI)", "Luxor (LXR)", "Sharm El-Sheikh (SSH)"],
  MA: ["Casablanca (CMN)", "Marrakech (RAK)", "Fes (FEZ)"],
  TH: ["Bangkok (BKK)", "Phuket (HKT)", "Chiang Mai (CNX)"],
  FR: ["Paris CDG (CDG)", "Paris Orly (ORY)", "Nice (NCE)"],
  IT: ["Rome (FCO)", "Milan (MXP)", "Venice (VCE)"],
  GB: ["London Heathrow (LHR)", "London Gatwick (LGW)", "Manchester (MAN)"],
  US: ["New York JFK (JFK)", "Los Angeles (LAX)", "Chicago (ORD)"],
};

// Values stay English for the office email; labels come from translations.
const timeSpans: TimeSpanKey[] = ["Day", "Night"];

  { id: "family", icon: <FaUsers /> },
  { id: "couple", icon: <FaHeart /> },
  { id: "solo", icon: <FaUser /> },
  { id: "friends", icon: <FaUserFriends /> },
];

const durations: DurationKey[] = ["3-5", "7", "10", "14", "custom"];

const preferences: PreferenceOption[] = [

  { id: "airport", icon: <FaPlaneArrival /> },
  { id: "guide", icon: <FaUserTie /> },
  { id: "meals", icon: <FaUtensils /> },
];

// Simple email & phone validators
const isValidEmail = (value: string): boolean =>
  /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value.trim());

const isValidPhone = (value: string): boolean =>
  /^[+]?[\d\s()-]{7,}$/.test(value.trim());

// ─── Component ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function CustomTravelPackages({ mode = "packages" }: CustomTravelPackagesProps): JSX.Element {
  const isUmrah = mode === "umrah";

  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const t = getCustomPackagesTranslation(language);
  const direction = getDirection(language);
  const fieldId = useId();

  // Localized country names for display only; falls back to the English name.
  const regionNames = useMemo(() => {
    try {
      return new Intl.DisplayNames([language], { type: "region", fallback: "none" });
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }, [language]);

  const getCountryLabel = (item: Country): string =>
    regionNames?.of(item.code) || item.name;

  // ─── State ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const [fullName, setFullName]             = useState<string>("");
  const [email, setEmail]                   = useState<string>("");
  const [phone, setPhone]                   = useState<string>("");
  const [country, setCountry]               = useState<CountryCode>("SA");
  const [airport, setAirport]               = useState<string>("");
  const [timeSpan, setTimeSpan]             = useState<string>("");
  const [travelType, setTravelType]         = useState<TravelTypeKey>("couple");
  const [duration, setDuration]             = useState<DurationKey>("10");
  const [customDays, setCustomDays]         = useState<string>("");
  const [adults, setAdults]                 = useState<number>(2);
  const [children, setChildren]             = useState<number>(0);
  const [infants, setInfants]               = useState<number>(0);
  const [selectedPrefs, setSelectedPrefs]   = useState<PreferenceKey[]>(["airport"]);
  const [specialRequests, setSpecialRequests] = useState<string>("");
  const [status, setStatus]                 = useState<SubmitStatus>("idle");
  const [touched, setTouched]               = useState<{ email: boolean; phone: boolean }>({
    email: false,
    phone: false,
  });

  // Clear the "success" reset timer if the component unmounts.
  const resetTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (resetTimer.current !== null) clearTimeout(resetTimer.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const togglePref = (id: PreferenceKey): void => {
    setSelectedPrefs((prev) =>
      prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((p) => p !== id) : [...prev, id]
    );
  };

  // ─── Validation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const emailError = touched.email && !isValidEmail(email)
    ? (email.trim() === "" ? t.errors.emailRequired : t.errors.emailInvalid)
    : "";

  const phoneError = touched.phone && !isValidPhone(phone)
    ? (phone.trim() === "" ? t.errors.phoneRequired : t.errors.phoneInvalid)
    : "";

  const isFormValid = isValidEmail(email) && isValidPhone(phone);

  // ─── Submit ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Payload is unchanged: English values, same keys as before.

  const handleSubmit = async (): Promise<void> => {
    // Mark mandatory fields as touched so errors show if invalid
    setTouched({ email: true, phone: true });

    if (!isFormValid) {
      return;
    }

    setStatus("loading");

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/send-email", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          formType: "travelQuote",
          pageType: isUmrah ? "umrah" : "packages",
          fullName,
          email,
          phone,
          country: countries.find((c) => c.code === country)?.name,
          airport: airport || airportsByCountry[country]?.[0] || "",
          timeSpan,
          travelType,
          duration: duration === "custom" ? `${customDays} Days` : `${duration} Days`,
          adults,
          children,
          infants,
          preferences: selectedPrefs.join(", "),
          specialRequests,
        }),
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        setStatus("success");
        if (resetTimer.current !== null) clearTimeout(resetTimer.current);
        resetTimer.current = setTimeout(() => setStatus("idle"), 3000);
      } else {
        setStatus("error");
      }
    } catch {
      setStatus("error");

    { id: "infants", label: t.travelers.infants, value: infants, setter: setInfants, min: 0, max: 5 },
  ];

    loading: "bg-[#0F91D5] opacity-60 cursor-not-allowed",
    success: "bg-green-500 shadow-lg shadow-green-200",
    error:   "bg-red-500 shadow-lg shadow-red-200",
  }[status];

  const heading = isUmrah ? t.heading.umrah : t.heading.packages;
  const description = isUmrah ? t.description.umrah : t.description.packages;

  const ids = {

    airport: `${fieldId}-airport`,
    timeSpan: `${fieldId}-time-span`,

    emailError: `${fieldId}-email-error`,
    phoneError: `${fieldId}-phone-error`,
  };

  // ─── Render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

            {heading.start}

                    );
                  })}
                </div>

                />

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import Link from "next/link";

import {
  FaFacebookF,
  FaInstagram,
  FaTiktok,
  FaLinkedinIn,
} from "react-icons/fa";

import { HiOutlineLocationMarker } from "react-icons/hi";
import { FiMail, FiPhone } from "react-icons/fi";

import { useLanguage } from "../LanguageProvider";
import { footerTranslations } from "../../translations/footer";
import { getDirection, isSupportedLocale, FALLBACK_LOCALE } from "@/i18n";

type FooterTranslation = {
  [Key in keyof typeof footerTranslations.en]: string;
};

function getFooterTranslation(language: string): FooterTranslation {
  const normalized = language.trim().toLowerCase().split(/[-_]/)[0];
  const locale = isSupportedLocale(normalized) ? normalized : FALLBACK_LOCALE;
  const fallback: FooterTranslation = footerTranslations.en;
  const selected: Partial<FooterTranslation> | undefined =
    footerTranslations[locale as keyof typeof footerTranslations];
  const result: FooterTranslation = { ...fallback };

  for (const key of Object.keys(fallback) as Array<keyof FooterTranslation>) {
    const label = selected?.[key];
    if (typeof label === "string" && label.trim().length > 0) {
      result[key] = label;
    }
  }

  return result;
}

export default function LegalPageShell({
  page,
  contentLang,
  showHeader = true,
  children,
}: {
  page: LegalPageKey;
  /** Language the legal text is written in. */
  contentLang: ContentLanguage;
  /** Algemene Voorwaarden has no hero header in the original page. */
  showHeader?: boolean;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const t = getLegalTranslation(language);
  const visitorLocale = resolveLocale(language);

  const showNotice = visitorLocale !== contentLang;
  const notice =
    contentLang === "en" ? t.notice.onlyEnglish : t.notice.onlyDutch;

  return (
    <main dir={getDirection(language)} className="w-full text-gray-800">
      {showHeader && <CommonHeader heading={t.headings[page]} />}

      {showNotice && (
        <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 pt-6">
          <p
            role="note"
            className="rounded-xl border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-[#0F91D5] text-start"
          >
            {notice}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Legal text: original language, always left-to-right */}
      <div lang={contentLang} dir="ltr">
        {children}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

"use client";

import React from "react";
import { useLanguage } from "@/components/LanguageProvider";
import { getDirection } from "@/i18n";
import { getHomepageTranslation, homepageTranslations } from "@/translations/homepage";

interface Props {
  icon: React.ReactNode;

  /**
   * Preferred: key into homepageTranslations[lang].sideIcons
   * The card then follows the selected language automatically.
   */
  itemKey?: string;

  /**
   * Legacy plain text. Still fully supported: if the English wording matches an
   * entry in homepageTranslations.en.sideIcons the card is translated anyway,
   * so the parent does not have to be touched.
   */
  title?: string;
  desc?: string;
}

interface SideIconDescProps {
  data: {
    /**
     * Preferred: key into homepageTranslations[lang].sideSections
     * Supplies both the heading and the intro line.
     */
    sectionKey?: string;

    /** Legacy plain text — matched against the English copy, same as above. */
    head?: string | React.ReactNode;
    details?: string;

    data: Props[];
  };
}

/** "  Expert   Visa Solutions " -> "expert visa solutions" */
const normalize = (value: string) =>
  value.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, " ");

/**
 * Reverse index: English heading / card title -> translation key.
 * Lets a parent that still passes plain English strings render translated,
 * without changing that parent.
 */
const buildEnglishIndex = () => {
  const en = homepageTranslations.en;

  const sections: Record<string, string> = {};
  Object.entries(en.sideSections).forEach(([key, value]) => {
    sections[normalize(value.head)] = key;
  });

  const icons: Record<string, string> = {};
  Object.entries(en.sideIcons).forEach(([key, value]) => {
    icons[normalize(value.title)] = key;
  });

  return { sections, icons };
};

const ENGLISH_INDEX = buildEnglishIndex();

const SideIconDesc = ({ data }: SideIconDescProps) => {
  const { language } = useLanguage();

  // Shared helper normalizes locale codes and applies English fallback for
  // missing or incomplete translations.
  const t = getHomepageTranslation(language);
  const en = homepageTranslations.en;

  // Heading: explicit key -> English wording match -> whatever the parent passed
  const sectionKey =
    data.sectionKey ??
    (typeof data.head === "string"
      ? ENGLISH_INDEX.sections[normalize(data.head)]
      : undefined);

  const section = sectionKey
    ? t.sideSections[sectionKey] || en.sideSections[sectionKey]
    : undefined;

  const head = section?.head ?? data.head;
  const details = section?.details ?? data.details;

  const getCard = (item: Props) => {
    const itemKey =
      item.itemKey ??
      (item.title ? ENGLISH_INDEX.icons[normalize(item.title)] : undefined);

    const translated = itemKey
      ? t.sideIcons[itemKey] || en.sideIcons[itemKey]
      : undefined;

    return {
      title: translated?.title ?? item.title ?? "",
      desc: translated?.desc ?? item.desc ?? "",
    };
  };

  return (
    // Background image aur style tag hata diya hai, ab yeh clean background hai
    <section
      dir={getDirection(language)}
      className="py-12 sm:py-20 px-4 sm:px-8 md:px-16 relative container mx-auto"
    >
      <div className="text-center">
        {/* TITLE */}
        <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold">{head}</h2>

        <p className="text-gray-600 mt-2 mb-12 px-2">{details}</p>
      </div>

      {/* CARDS */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:flex lg:flex-row lg:items-stretch gap-6 sm:gap-8 px-0 sm:px-4 md:px-8">
        {data.data.map((item, ind) => {
          const card = getCard(item);

          return (
            <div
              key={ind}
              // Cards ka background transparent se badal kar solid white (bg-white) ya shadow smooth kar diya hai
              className="bg-white border border-gray-100 rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition flex-1 "
            >
              {/* ICON */}
              <div className="w-12 h-12 sm:w-14 sm:h-14 mb-4 flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#0F91D5] text-white text-lg sm:text-xl shadow">
                {item.icon}
              </div>

              <h3 className="font-semibold text-base sm:text-lg text-black">
                {card.title}
              </h3>

              <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-600 mt-2 leading-relaxed">
                {card.desc}
              </p>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* PARTNERS */}
    </section>
  );
};

export default SideIconDesc;

// Duplicate for seamless loop
const allAirlines = [...airlines, ...airlines];

export default function AirlineSlider() {
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const home = getHomepageTranslation(language);
  const section =
    home.sideSections.airlinePartners ??
    getHomepageTranslation("en").sideSections.airlinePartners;
  const sliderText = getSliderTranslation(language);

  const trackRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const positionRef = useRef(0);          // current x offset
  const speedRef = useRef(2);             // px per frame (auto-scroll speed)
  const rafRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const isPausedRef = useRef(false);
  const isDraggingRef = useRef(false);
  const dragStartXRef = useRef(0);
  const dragStartPosRef = useRef(0);
  const singleWidthRef = useRef(0);

  // Calculate single set width after mount and run the auto-scroll loop
  useEffect(() => {
    const track = trackRef.current;
    if (!track) return;

    // Width of one set = total / 2 (since we duplicated)
    singleWidthRef.current = track.scrollWidth / 2;

    function animate() {
      if (!isPausedRef.current && !isDraggingRef.current) {
        positionRef.current += speedRef.current;

        // Reset when first set scrolled past
        if (positionRef.current >= singleWidthRef.current) {
          positionRef.current -= singleWidthRef.current;
        }
      }

      if (track) {
        track.style.transform = `translateX(-${positionRef.current}px)`;
      }

      rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
  }, []);

  // ── MOUSE EVENTS ──────────────────────────────────────────
  const onMouseEnter = () => { isPausedRef.current = true; };
  const onMouseLeave = () => {
    isPausedRef.current = false;
    isDraggingRef.current = false;
  };

  const onMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    isDraggingRef.current = true;
    dragStartXRef.current = e.clientX;
    dragStartPosRef.current = positionRef.current;
  };

  const onMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (!isDraggingRef.current) return;
    const delta = dragStartXRef.current - e.clientX;
    let newPos = dragStartPosRef.current + delta;

    // Keep within bounds (looping)
    const single = singleWidthRef.current;
    if (newPos < 0) newPos += single;
    if (newPos >= single) newPos -= single;

    positionRef.current = newPos;
  };

  const onMouseUp = () => {
    isDraggingRef.current = false;
    isPausedRef.current = false; // resume auto-scroll
  };

  // ── TOUCH EVENTS ──────────────────────────────────────────
  const onTouchStart = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    const touch = e.touches[0];
    if (!touch) return;
    isPausedRef.current = true;
    isDraggingRef.current = true;
    dragStartXRef.current = touch.clientX;
    dragStartPosRef.current = positionRef.current;
  };

  const onTouchMove = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    if (!isDraggingRef.current) return;
    const touch = e.touches[0];
    if (!touch) return;
    const delta = dragStartXRef.current - touch.clientX;
    let newPos = dragStartPosRef.current + delta;

    const single = singleWidthRef.current;
    if (newPos < 0) newPos += single;
    if (newPos >= single) newPos -= single;

    positionRef.current = newPos;
  };

  const onTouchEnd = () => {
    isDraggingRef.current = false;
    isPausedRef.current = false; // resume
  };

  return (
    <section
      dir={getDirection(language)}
      className="relative w-full py-16 sm:py-24 overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-b from-white to-sky-50"
    >
      <div className="container mx-auto px-4 sm:px-8 md:px-16">
        <div className="text-center mb-14">
          <h2 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold text-gray-800">
            {section?.head}
          </h2>

          <p className="mt-3 text-gray-500 text-lg">
            {section?.details}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-10">
          {/*
            Logos carry no text direction, and the loop math assumes the
            track starts on the left, so the slider itself stays LTR.
          */}
          <div
            dir="ltr"
            className="relative w-full overflow-hidden cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing select-none"
            onMouseEnter={onMouseEnter}
            onMouseLeave={onMouseLeave}
            onMouseDown={onMouseDown}
            onMouseMove={onMouseMove}
            onMouseUp={onMouseUp}
            onTouchStart={onTouchStart}
            onTouchMove={onTouchMove}
            onTouchEnd={onTouchEnd}
          >
            {/* Inner track — moved via transform in rAF */}
            <div
              ref={trackRef}
              className="flex w-max items-center will-change-transform"
            >
              {allAirlines.map((airline, i) => (
                <div
                  key={i}
                  // The second copy only exists for the loop; hide it from screen readers.
                  aria-hidden={i >= airlines.length ? true : undefined}
                  className="
                    mx-5
                    flex
                    h-28
                    w-56
                    items-center
                    justify-center
                    rounded-2xl
                    bg-white
                    shadow-md
                    transition-all
                    duration-300
                    hover:-translate-y-2
                    hover:shadow-xl
                    hover:scale-105
                    border
                    border-gray-100
                    flex-shrink-0
                  "
                >
                  <Image
                    src={airline.src}
                    alt={interpolate(sliderText.logoAlt, { number: airline.number })}
                    width={180}
                    height={90}
                    draggable={false}
                    className="
                      max-h-20
                      max-w-[180px]
                      object-contain
                      pointer-events-none
                      select-none
                    "
                  />
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * HASSAAN TRAVEL — GENERIC TRANSLATION FACTORY
 * ============================================
 *
 * Shared by every page-level translations file (umrah, visa, packages, ...).
 * Locale configuration stays in apps/web/i18n.ts.
 *
 * Behaviour:
 * - "nl-NL", "nl_BE", "NL" all resolve to "nl".
 * - Unsupported locales fall back to English.
 * - Missing keys fall back to English per key.
 * - An explicit empty string ("") is kept as-is. Use it for heading parts
 *   a language does not need, e.g. { start: "", highlight: "…", end: "…" }.
 * - Empty or missing arrays fall back to the English array.
 * - Results are cached per locale, so the same object is returned every time.
 *
 * Usage:
 *
 *   const en = { header: { title: "Umrah" }, steps: ["One", "Two"] } as const;
 *
 *   export const getUmrahTranslation = createTranslator(en, {
 *     nl: { header: { title: "Umrah" }, steps: ["Een", "Twee"] },
 *     ur: { header: { title: "عمرہ" } },
 *   });
 *
 *   // In a client component:
 *   const { language } = useLanguage();
 *   const t = getUmrahTranslation(language);
 */

import { FALLBACK_LOCALE, isSupportedLocale, type Locale } from "@/i18n";

type AnyFunction = (...args: never[]) => unknown;

/** Turns `as const` literal types into plain string / number / array types. */
export type Widen<T> = T extends AnyFunction
  ? T
  : T extends string
    ? string
    : T extends number
      ? number
      : T extends boolean
        ? boolean
        : T extends readonly (infer U)[]
          ? Widen<U>[]
          : T extends object
            ? { -readonly [K in keyof T]: Widen<T[K]> }
            : T;

/**
 * Shape allowed for non-English dictionaries.
 * Objects may be incomplete; arrays are replaced as a whole.
 */
export type PartialTranslation<T> = T extends AnyFunction
  ? T
  : T extends readonly unknown[]
    ? T
    : T extends object
      ? { [K in keyof T]?: PartialTranslation<T[K]> }
      : T;

/** Normalizes any incoming language value to a supported Locale. */
export function resolveLocale(language: unknown): Locale {
  if (typeof language !== "string") return FALLBACK_LOCALE;

  const base = language.trim().toLowerCase().split(/[-_]/)[0] ?? "";

  return isSupportedLocale(base) ? base : FALLBACK_LOCALE;
}

function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) {
    return false;
  }

  const prototype = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
  return prototype === Object.prototype || prototype === null;
}

function hasOwn(source: Record<string, unknown>, key: string): boolean {
  return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(source, key);
}

/** Fills missing values from English without modifying either source object. */
function mergeWithFallback(fallback: unknown, selected: unknown): unknown {
  if (typeof fallback === "string") {
    // Any provided string wins, including an intentional "".
    // Only a missing or non-string value falls back to English.
    return typeof selected === "string" ? selected : fallback;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(fallback)) {
    return Array.isArray(selected) && selected.length > 0 ? selected : fallback;
  }

  if (isPlainObject(fallback)) {
    const source = isPlainObject(selected) ? selected : {};
    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};

    // Keep extra keys that exist only in the selected language.
    for (const key of Object.keys(source)) {
      result[key] = source[key];
    }

    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(fallback)) {
      result[key] = mergeWithFallback(
        value,
        hasOwn(source, key) ? source[key] : undefined
      );
    }

    return result;
  }

  return selected === undefined || selected === null ? fallback : selected;
}

/**
 * Builds a cached lookup function for one dictionary set.
 * English is the complete base; every other language may be partial.
 */
export function createTranslator<T extends object>(
  english: T,
  translations: Partial<
    Record<Exclude<Locale, "en">, PartialTranslation<Widen<T>>>
  >
): (language: unknown) => Widen<T> {
  const cache = new Map<Locale, Widen<T>>();

  return function getTranslation(language: unknown): Widen<T> {
    const locale = resolveLocale(language);

    const cached = cache.get(locale);
    if (cached) return cached;

    const selected = locale === "en" ? undefined : translations[locale];
    const result = mergeWithFallback(english, selected) as Widen<T>;

    cache.set(locale, result);
    return result;
  };
}

/**
 * Replaces {placeholders} in a translated string.
 * Unknown placeholders are left untouched so missing values stay visible.
 *
 *   interpolate("{count} months ago", { count: 5 }) -> "5 months ago"
 */
export function interpolate(
  template: string,
  values: Record<string, string | number>
): string {
  return template.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, key: string) =>
    hasOwn(values, key) ? String(values[key]) : match
  );
}

/**
 * HASSAAN TRAVEL — LANGUAGE UTILITIES
 * Locale configuration remains in apps/web/i18n.ts.
 */
import {
  DEFAULT_LOCALE,
  FALLBACK_LOCALE,
  LOCALES,
  type Locale,
  isSupportedLocale,
} from "@/i18n";

const LANGUAGE_KEY = "NEXT_LOCALE";
const COOKIE_MAX_AGE = 60 * 60 * 24 * 365;

// Preserve imports used by existing components.
export const LANGUAGES = LOCALES.map((locale) => ({
  code: locale.code,
  name: locale.label,
  flag: locale.flag,
}));

export const DEFAULT_LANGUAGE = DEFAULT_LOCALE;

function resolveLocale(value: unknown): Locale | null {
  if (typeof value !== "string") return null;

  const normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, "-");
  if (!normalized) return null;

  if (isSupportedLocale(normalized)) return normalized;

  const base = normalized.split("-")[0];
  if (isSupportedLocale(base)) return base;

  const match = LOCALES.find((locale) => {
    const code = locale.code.toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, "-");
    return code === normalized;
  }) ?? LOCALES.find((locale) => {
    const code = locale.code.toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, "-");
    return code.split("-")[0] === base;
  });

  return match?.code ?? null;
}

/** Read the cookie first, then localStorage if the cookie is unavailable. */
export function getSavedLanguage(): Locale | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;

  try {
    const cookie = document.cookie
      .split(";")
      .map((item) => item.trim())
      .find((item) => item.startsWith(`${LANGUAGE_KEY}=`));

    if (cookie) {
      const saved = resolveLocale(
        decodeURIComponent(cookie.slice(LANGUAGE_KEY.length + 1))
      );
      if (saved) return saved;
    }
  } catch {
    // Blocked cookies or malformed values must not prevent storage fallback.
  }

  try {
    return resolveLocale(window.localStorage.getItem(LANGUAGE_KEY));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Remember explicit selections; either storage mechanism may be blocked. */
export function saveLanguage(language: string): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;

  const locale = resolveLocale(language);
  if (!locale) return;

  try {
    const secure = window.location.protocol === "https:" ? "; Secure" : "";
    document.cookie = `${LANGUAGE_KEY}=${encodeURIComponent(locale)}; Path=/; Max-Age=${COOKIE_MAX_AGE}; SameSite=Lax${secure}`;
  } catch {
    // localStorage can still remember the choice when cookies are blocked.
  }

  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(LANGUAGE_KEY, locale);
  } catch {
    // Language switching still works for this session through the provider.
  }
}

/** Use the first supported browser preference without saving it. */
export function detectBrowserLanguage(): Locale {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || typeof navigator === "undefined") {
    return FALLBACK_LOCALE;
  }

  const preferences = [...(navigator.languages ?? []), navigator.language];

  for (const preference of preferences) {
    const locale = resolveLocale(preference);
    if (locale) return locale;
  }

  return FALLBACK_LOCALE;
}
